description.short: Permission-scoped sprint questions, standup recaps and approved follow-ups.
description.full: Answers five read-only sprint questions with your own Azure DevOps permissions: blockers, your commitments, sprint risk, today's standup status and your assigned items. Runs the daily standup, posts the recap and sends follow-up cards. Approving a card writes the agreed update to Azure DevOps as the approver.

commands.title: What is blocked on my team?
commands.description: Readable sprint blockers, with work item links.

commands.title: What did I commit to?
commands.description: Your recorded commitments linked to readable sprint items.

commands.title: What is at risk in this sprint?
commands.description: At-risk and overdue items computed by the sprint rules.

commands.title: What is the standup status today?
commands.description: Today's standup lifecycle in the team's time zone.

commands.title: Show my items and their state.
commands.description: Current-sprint items assigned to your verified Azure DevOps identity.

disclaimer.text: AI phrases the introduction; sprint facts and citations come from code with your Azure DevOps access. Changes require an approved follow-up.
